'''Praesitlyn''' was an astronomical object situated in the [[Sluis sector]]<ref name="THRA 6" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> In [[228 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{StarlightDate|[[The High Republic Adventures (2023) 4|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2023) 4]]|one [[Standard year|year]] and two weeks after the destruction of Starlight Beacon|[[228 BBY]]}} Since the events of [[The High Republic Adventures (2023) 6|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2023) 6]] are set immediately following the fourth issue's events—and depict the [[expansion of the Stormwall]]—the latter event must take place in the same year.</ref> during the [[High Republic Era]], Praesitlyn and the rest of its [[sector]] fell within the [[Occlusion Zone]] territory of the [[Nihil]] [[Pirate|marauders]] when its [[Stormwall]] barrier was [[Expansion of the Stormwall|expanded]] following an attempted Republic [[Assault on the Stormwall|assault]].<ref name="THRA 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Praesitlyn appeared on a map in the [[The High Republic Adventures (2023) 6|sixth issue]] of the [[2023]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series [[Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures (2023)|''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures'']], written by [[Daniel José Older]], illustrated by [[Harvey Tolibao]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="THRA 6" /> on [[May 29]], [[2024]]<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/3013-799/Star-Wars-The-High-Republic-Adventures-Phase-III-6|text=Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures Phase III #6}}</ref> as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia initiative's [[Phase III: Trials of the Jedi|Phase III]].<ref name="Phase">{{HighRepublicReaderGuide}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Praesitlyn/Legends|Praesitlyn]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|41|Praesitlyn}}</ref> was first mentioned in the 1991 novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]],<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> and first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']].<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>
